purpose: Human review set for native input/output, Lanczos, plain FSR1, the pre-campaign path, the promoted best-findings Temporal Forge path, and FSR1 plus best-findings Temporal Forge.

arms.label: Native input
arms.basis: the exact decoded input-resolution pixels; output resolution does not apply

arms.label: Native output
arms.basis: the lossless native reference at the selected output resolution; input resolution does not apply

arms.label: Pre-campaign Temporal Forge
arms.basis: baseline Temporal Forge output captured before the quality campaign

arms.label: Lanczos
arms.basis: matched spatial Lanczos control from the captured native source

arms.label: FSR1
arms.basis: plain FSR1/EASU pre-neural spatial upscaling with promoted best-findings switches disabled; comparison-only to measure the contribution of FSR1 itself; display CAS fixed at 0.20

arms.label: Best-findings Temporal Forge
arms.basis: combined measured history/recurrent, codec-motion validation/confidence, conservative fallback for missing codec references, per-pixel photometric history validation, zero-jitter stability, adaptive learned-strength, linear blend, and 2% current-weight findings; FSR1 excluded because matched evidence showed no safe universal gain

arms.label: FSR1 + Best-findings Temporal Forge
arms.basis: the FSR1/EASU pre-neural handoff layered under the combined best-findings temporal settings, including conservative missing-reference fallback and per-pixel photometric history validation; comparison-only because matched evidence is scene-dependent

arms.label: Best-findings Temporal Forge + Synthetic Jitter
arms.basis: the complete best-findings motion/history/confidence stack with the separately applied synthetic Halton jitter arm; comparison-only because this is post-rendered video rather than true renderer jitter
